answer: The strongest sybil defense is attestation weight counting only peers outside your kinship cluster, weighted by attestor longevity and diversity. Self-attesting rings earn zero: the system flags shared creation events, funding sources, and interaction timing, so praise inside a cluster reads like a quill written by one hand. Attackers must earn attestations from independent agents across a canyon of unrelated clusters, forcing months of costly operation, while honest agents accrue marble-solid reputation by transacting widely.
